title: Eleven JA Joomla quickstarts with no slot contract (batch 3) carry one: five ready and measured on their releases (Focus, Good, Healthcare, Insight, Justitia), five not ready with the reason, JA Intranet without one (its release answers 500 on Joomla 6); a switch-only release stands up and builds
steps: S1: node --test test/tokenize.test.mjs test/slot.test.mjs test/cms.test.mjs test/release-manifest.test.mjs (cwd packages/design/tracy-ds-slot).
S2: read templates/joomla-ja-{focus,good,healthcare,insight,justitia,fresco,gamex,helple,kidscorner,landscape}.json through loadContract; look for templates/joomla-ja-intranet.json.

S3: apps/tracy-web/src/lib/ds-slot.js contractFor(templateKeyOf({platform:'joomla', template})) for ja_focus, ja_justitia, ja_gamex, ja_intranet; and for ja_focus with the site's quickstart version 1.0.1 and 1.0.0.

S4: node packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/scripts/pass-joomla.mjs <slug> --port 52733 --cdp 9741 --evidence <tmp> for ja-focus (installer zip + tracy_setting.json only) then ja-justitia (t4Placeholders): release restored in Docker, stylesheets tokenized, Moxie, MotherDuck, Toggl Track and Apple worn, cleared, stand removed.
expect: S1: every test passes, none skipped.

S2: the five are ready with a readyNote naming tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-batch3-2026-10-11; the other five, not ready in batch 3, are ready now (JA Fresco in round 2 r2b, REG-PR-1134-ds-contracts-r2b; Gamex, Helple, Kidscorner and Landscape in r2c, REG-PR-1134-ds-contracts-r2c); joomla-ja-intranet.json ready (absent in batch 3; added with the repaired 1.0.1, REG-PR-1134-ds-contracts-intranet); ja-justitia has no t4SiteCss, t4Placeholders.__body_text_color 'fg' and a readyNote saying regeneration-checked; ja-good has measuredPage '/index.php/home-layouts/home-news'; each of the five has minVersion {'quickstart/<slug>/j6': '1.0.1'}.

S3: {contract:'joomla-ja-focus'}, {contract:'joomla-ja-justitia'}, {contract:'joomla-ja-gamex'} (TEMPLATE_NOT_READY until round 2), {contract:'joomla-ja-intranet'} (TEMPLATE_HAS_NO_SLOT until the repaired re-release); ja_focus at 1.0.1 → the contract, at 1.0.0 → TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE.
S4: each: controls 0,0,0,0; no text under 4.5:1 that is worse than the template's own default; at least 60% of the painted page follows every system.

selectors.joomla: #__modules row title 'Tracy design system', module mod_custom, menuid 0; <style id="tracy-ds-slot">

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-contracts-batch3-2026-10-11/README.md — per-template table, screenshots, flow.json of each measure (11/10/2026).
fence: Two of the five ready templates re-measured (the switch-only path and t4Placeholders); the other three are in the evidence. Not covered: the re-releases built for upload (verified by release-batch.mjs verify, VERIFICATION.json in each pack) and publishing (no upload is made). Judging by eye (Gamex, Kidscorner) is in the evidence, not in a probe.
